# HR Annual Leave and Medical Insurance Management

This document outlines key tasks for the management of annual leave and medical insurance:

*   Monitor medical insurance quarterly.
*   Monitor annual leave quarterly.
*   Review annual leave urgently.
*   Update annual leave for strategy 2026.
*   Optimize annual leave quarterly.
